vocabulary.definition: a natural number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself
vocabulary.example: The number 7 is a prime number because it is only divisible by 1 and 7.

vocabulary.definition: capable of being divided by a specific number without a remainder
vocabulary.example: 12 is divisible by 3, as 12 divided by 3 gives a whole number, 4.

vocabulary.definition: implying that something bad is going to happen; ominous
